roles.B: Incident coordinator 事故协调同事

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What is the user impact of this incident?
dialogue.zh: 这次事故对用户有什么影响？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Some users cannot complete checkout on their phone.
dialogue.zh: 部分用户无法在手机上完成结账。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: How many users are affected, and is there a workaround?
dialogue.zh: 有多少用户受影响？有没有临时替代办法？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: About ten percent. They can use the website while we investigate.
dialogue.zh: 大约百分之十。我们调查期间，他们可以使用网站。

image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure SOLID BLACK background, bright clean WHITE line art. Minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No colors, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI symbols allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure coworkers stand beside a desk discussing an incident. The coworker on the RIGHT holds a large smartphone upright outward, clearly separated from their body. Its screen shows one simple outlined shopping-cart icon and a small warning triangle, no text or digits. Left coworker listens with concerned open palms. Whole phone with rounded handset frame is fully visible and easy to crop.

coverage_review.scope: W065 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/W065.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 通过：纯黑背景白色火柴人线稿，单幅双人工作沟通场景、底图无文字；右侧人物持有的完整实体手机可定位；用户故障由对白说明。 其余3词仅以明确对白支持，不虚构局部框。 局部裁剪复查后扩大右/下边界，保护完整道具。
